name: Elgato Marketplace
what_it_is: Elgato's store for Stream Deck plugins, icons, profiles, audio effects and OBS scene collections.
platforms: Web store; assets install to Stream Deck, Wave Link and OBS
pricing: Mix of free and paid items; each listing sets its own price.
notable: Visual overlays from some designers now sit under this marketplace

facts.fact: The marketplace describes itself as a place to find plugins, designs and more, curated by Elgato, with items listed as Free or priced.
For streamers it lists live designs and interactive widgets that apply directly in OBS, and OBS Scene Collections through Marketplace Connect.
Elgato says it was founded in 1999, was acquired by Corsair Gaming, Inc. in 2018, and is based in Germany and California.

name: SAMMI
what_it_is: Free stream automation toolkit that lets Twitch and YouTube Live audiences trigger buttons, OBS actions and alerts.
platforms: Desktop app (download page), plus SAMMI Panel on desktop and web browsers
pricing: Described by the vendor as completely free; license details are on a separate license page.
notable: Integrations listed for Meld Studio, Mix It Up, Elgato Stream Deck, Voicemod and Crowd Control

facts.fact: The homepage calls SAMMI a completely free tool to automate your streams, with a free Core app.
It connects to OBS WebSocket, listens to Twitch and YouTube Live events, sends chat messages and edits channel point rewards, using visual programming.
The documentation lists integrations with Crowd Control, Elgato Stream Deck, Meld Studio, Mix It Up, OBS Studio, Pulsoid, Twitch, Voicemod and YouTube Live.
